summary: Frontend regression testing for SideLamps visibility breakpoint change (1150px -> 900px). All 5 requested checks PASSED. Lamps visible at 1100x800, 1024x768 (88px medallions in 112px column), 1440x900 (118px medallions in 150px column). Hidden at 820x1000 with no horizontal overflow. Venue directions link clickable at 1024px, all sections present, 18 petals rendering, 0 console errors. Diya images loaded (naturalWidth=1024).
critical_code_review_comments: SideLamps.tsx sets nth-child inline top styles via `positions[]` but enhancements.css also has nth-child(n) { top: X% } rules that override them - inline styles should win due to specificity, but the JS positions [16%,48%,80%] differ from CSS [10%,42%,74%]. Since inline style takes precedence, JS values apply. Minor inconsistency worth cleaning up (either remove CSS nth-child rules or remove inline top).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 verified new lamp breakpoints (900px hide, 1300px shrink to 88px). Public URL preview OK. Verified viewports: 1100x800, 1024x768, 1440x900 (visible); 820x1000 (hidden, display:none). No overflow at any viewport. Envelope open flow works via #open hash and data-testid=open-invitation-button. Venue link data-testid=venue-directions-link is clickable at 1024w (lamps have pointer-events:none, z-index:5).
rca of the issue: Original bug: lamps hidden on user's laptop because CSS `@media (max-width: 1150px) { display: none }`. Fix (verified): breakpoint moved to 900px with intermediate 1300px rule shrinking medallions to 88px. Confirmed working at all target viewports.
